headline: Kambi Group Upgrades 2026 Guidance Following Strong Third Quarter
summary: Kambi Group has raised its full-year 2026 financial guidance following a strong performance in the third quarter.
why: Guidance upgrades signal stronger-than-expected operational momentum and are frequently catalysts for analyst estimate revisions.

impacts.name: Kambi Group
impacts.why: An upward revision to forward-looking financial guidance typically drives positive equity valuation adjustments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
